2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 10.05.1994 and 28.10.1994.

The Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offences),
Siddharth Nagar vide order dated 10.05.1994 convicted revisionist and sentenced him for six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as ?Act, 1954?).
